bio: Part of a popular dining hub near the Silnica river, this intimate eatery is ideal for date night thanks to its small size and gentle buzz. The highly appealing menu is filled with European classics executed with skill by the chefs. For evidence, order the fabulous Wiener schnitzel that could stand shoulder-to-shoulder with those in Vienna. Other dishes from beef tartare to chicken terrine are in a similar vein: generous, well-priced and utilising tried-and-tested combinations to great effect.
